taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from 3rd to 8th week of development.

words.clue: Process that converts the bilaminar disc into a trilaminar disc with three germ layers.
Structure extending from oropharyngeal to cloacal membrane that induces neural plate formation.
Germ layer that forms skin, nervous system, and sense organs.
Germ layer giving rise to muscles, skeleton, and cardiovascular system.
Germ layer that develops into the epithelium of the gut, liver, and pancreas.
Process by which the notochord induces the overlying ectoderm to form the neural plate.
Mesenchymal tissue derived from somites that condenses around the notochord to form vertebral bodies.
Gelatinous core of the intervertebral disc that is a remnant of the notochord.
Layer of the bilaminar disc from which cells migrate through the primitive groove during gastrulation.
Fibrous ring that surrounds the nucleus pulposus in the intervertebral disc.
Benign tumor arising from retained notochordal remnants in the sacrococcygeal region.
Mesodermal segments that give rise to sclerotomes, myotomes, and dermatomes.
